title: Two friendly sites share one deployment before permission isolation
description:
Requested by Humorus (https://github.com/AnthusAI/Humorus), the satire publications that run a second, very different newsroom on Papyrus. Humorus issue: HUM-265b5b.

An early milestone for PPY-6a6357: two sites with the same editors on one deployment. It needs tenant scoping in every list, host-to-site routing at the edge, per-site output folders and per-site policy data. It does not need permission isolation or billing.
